name: Copper Verdigris
replaces: Isomer core palette (Isomer Blue, Accent Purple, Secondary Orange)
summary: Copper signals. Verdigris acts. Black, white and grey carry the page. Outside the work, copper and verdigris are the brand.

semantics.copper: In the work: risk found, flagged, rising, warning, too late. In a brand moment: the metal, the mark.
semantics.verdigris: In the work: action, whoever takes it. Isomer acting in a figure; what the reader can do in a product (links, selection, focus, controls, advice). In a brand moment: the patina, the field.
semantics.oxide-red: critical or irreversible (status only, always with its word)
semantics.cobalt: OK, healthy, info (status only, always with its word)
semantics.graphite: screens of data, and the dark product theme
semantics.neutrals: every frame: rules, panels, tabs, chart bars, numbers, dates, labels, the ruler

typography.note: Fustat is the current Isomer brand face, kept on purpose. Plex Mono replaces Geist Mono so the annotation layer doesn't read like other claims-AI sites.

families.title: Neutrals
families.description: About 85% of any surface. Graphite has a trace of green so it sits with the verdigris.

families.title: Copper · the signal
families.description: In the work: risk flags, HIGH tags, "too late", rising. Doubles as the warning color. As brand: the metal in the mark, a cover, one hero word. Never on eyebrows, labels or numbers that aren't risky. Never a full-bleed background.

colors.name: Copper
colors.use: Risk marks, too-late dots, the 8px 'why it matters' square

colors.name: Copper deep
colors.use: Brand moments on light grounds: the mark, a cover, one hero word. Not eyebrows or labels

colors.name: Copper dark
colors.use: Risk text and labels on light grounds (6.8:1 on white)

colors.name: Copper light
colors.use: Risk on graphite and in the dark theme; the metal on dark brand fields

families.title: Verdigris · the action
families.description: In the work: action, whoever takes it. ACT pills, the X-ray scan line and Isomer outcomes in figures; links, selection, controls and focus in a product. As brand: the patina field.

colors.name: Verdigris
colors.use: Action marks, ACT pills, the 8px 'what you can do' square. Not text on white (4.0:1)

colors.name: Verdigris deep
colors.use: Links, selected state, focus rings, action text on light (6.1:1 on white)

colors.name: Verdigris light
colors.use: Action on graphite and in the dark theme; scan line on screens

families.title: Status · for apps
families.description: Three states, not four. Warning reuses copper. Red is reserved for critical or broken. Cobalt means healthy and doubles as info. Always pair status color with a label or icon.

distinctiveness: Copper and verdigris carry the identity in brand moments (logo, covers, title slides, one hero moment) and carry meaning everywhere else. Never both jobs on one surface.
Carry the plate apparatus (rulers, plate codes, scan line) into page UI in grey, low opacity. Copper ticks on a ruler are decoration.
Avoid category-default patterns: big-number tiles over a mono caption row, dark 'extraction' text blocks, numbered section eyebrows, red/green status dots without a word.
Make time the subject: show when something was caught, not just what a file contains.

brand.what: Copper and verdigris as identity: the patina story, copper becoming verdigris.
where: Covers: decks, reports, blog headers, social cards
One hero moment per marketing page: a headline word or the hero field
rules: At most one brand moment per screen or page view.
A brand moment carries no data. Once a figure, table or product screen appears, color means something.
The pair may sit together here, and only here: verdigris as the field, copper as the smaller, brighter metal.
On light grounds use copper deep and verdigris deep; on ink or verdigris-dark fields use copper light and verdigris light.

signal.what: Copper and verdigris as verbs, inside the work: figures, product screens, email, charts, tables.
where: Any page section that shows data or claims
rules: Copper appears only where something is risky. If nothing on the screen is, the screen has no copper.
Verdigris appears only where something is being done, or can be.
Everything else is ink and grey: rules, panels, tabs, numbers, eyebrows, the ruler.
One meaning per color, one color per element.
